title: Universal-modder before commit e88f6876745427321eb755ebc98276063a962d8a contains a missing WebSocket Origin validation…
description: Universal-modder before commit e88f6876745427321eb755ebc98276063a962d8a has a vulnerability in the HostLink class of its passthrough example mods where WebSocket Origin validation is missing. This flaw allows remote attackers to connect cross-site to an unauthenticated loopback WebSocket and execute Minecraft commands with operator privileges via the WorldBridge.command() function.
